title: Sofia, 28, an atomic bomb!
details: Even if, at 28, Sofia has a somewhat dull sex life with a husband much older than her, the beautiful Belarusian is nonetheless very much in love with him. And this famous professor of psychology does him well by showing him also a great tolerance in matters of sex… A modus vivendi that suits our friend Rico, who takes great pleasure in frolicking with this sublime young woman.
